system.description:
When you see an allied creature cast a jutsu, you create a tornado like mass that is released as a shockwave.

All hostile creatures in a 60-foot cone, originating from you, must make a Strength saving throw or be pulled 20 feet towards your allied creature falling Prone and take 5d6 wind damage on a failed save or half as much and no further effect.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, this jutsu gains the Barrier keyword and the triggering creature gains a barrier of wind with a number of temporary hit points equal to the result damage this jutsu rolls. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, and initiates a Clash the triggering allied creature rolls their Clash check as well, and you can choose which result you want to use, yours or theirs. On a failure, only you suffer the effects of the clash.
